issues.problem: wooite explain said をおいて must always end in a negative, so a learner would reject the common rhetorical-question form 彼をおいてほかに誰がいるだろうか.
issues.action: Added the rhetorical-question ending as the one exception, with an example.

issues.problem: Intro glossed おろか as 'foolish'; in はおろか it is 疎か ('not worth/inadequate to mention'), so the etymology was misleading.
issues.action: Rewrote the opening as 'A is too obvious even to be worth mentioning'.

issues.problem: Explain said that in a positive sentence the 'bigger' thing comes first; it is the easier/more expected one (国内はおろか海外でも).
issues.action: Changed 'bigger or nearer' to 'easier or nearer'.

issues.problem: Example スマホはおろか、パソコンも: which device is the 'extreme' case is debatable, so the order rule is not clearly shown.
issues.action: Replaced with 祖父は海外はおろか、東京にも行ったことがない.

issues.problem: Example 貯金はおろか…家賃さえ払えない: the predicate 払えない does not fit A (you don't 'pay' savings).
issues.action: Rewrote as 貯金はおろか、今月の家賃を払うお金さえない with matching English.

issues.problem: toiedomo contrast said ながらも does not follow a status noun; 子どもながら(も) is standard.
issues.action: Rewrote the note: ながらも joins two contrasting traits of one subject (with 子どもながらも example); といえども says a rule applies even to X.

issues.problem: towaie contrast said ながらも attaches only to verb stems or adjectives.
towaie example 1 English 'the cold days are continuing' was unnatural.
issues.action: Changed to 'It may be spring, but we're still getting cold days.'
